occurrences.exact_quote:
| Layer | Babylonian example | SOL relevance |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Phonetic | Syllabic spellings such as *ba*, *bi*, *bu* | Consonant and vowel encoded together |
| Logographic | Sumerian `LUGAL` used for Akkadian *šarrum*, “king” | Written sign and spoken word differ |
| Determinative | Divine classifier `DINGIR` before a deity name | A symbol can specify type without being pronounced |
| Morphological | Akkadian *šarrum*, *šarram*, *šarri* | Case endings distinguish grammatical functions |
| Numerical | Sexagesimal place-value notation | Structural number representation, separate from linguistic meaning |
